title: Apply Mechanically
simplified_paragraphs: 一家饭馆的服务员请一位顾客猜谜语,他说：”我母亲和我父亲生了个孩子，既不是我兄弟，也不是我姐妹，此人是谁？”顾客回答不上来，服务员告诉他：”是我。”
这位顾客回家后就拿这个谜语让朋友猜：”我父母生了个孩子，既不是我兄弟，也不是我姐妹，此人是谁？””不知道，”他的朋友问，”是谁？”这位顾客回答：”是一个服务员。”
当我们自己不能断定我们是否真的明白了一切的时候，向其他人重复那个我们认识的事实，就是一件最愚蠢的事情。
traditional_paragraphs: 一家飯館的服務員請一位顧客猜謎語,他說：”我母親和我父親生了個孩子，既不是我兄弟，也不是我姐妹，此人是誰？”顧客回答不上來，服務員告訴他：”是我。”
這位顧客回家後就拿這個謎語讓朋友猜：”我父母生了個孩子，既不是我兄弟，也不是我姐妹，此人是誰？””不知道，”他的朋友問，”是誰？”這位顧客回答：”是一個服務員。”
當我們自己不能斷定我們是否真的明白了一切的時候，向其他人重複那個我們認識的事實，就是一件最愚蠢的事情。
pinyin_paragraphs: yī jiā fàn guǎn de fú wù yuán qǐng yī wèi gù kè cāi mí yǔ , tā shuō：” wǒ mǔ qīn hé wǒ fù qīn shēng le gè hái zi， jì bù shì wǒ xiōng dì， yě bù shì wǒ jiě mèi， cǐ rén shì shéi？” gù kè huí dá bù shàng lái， fú wù yuán gào su tā：” shì wǒ。”

zhè wèi gù kè huí jiā hòu jiù ná zhè gè mí yǔ ràng péng you cāi：” wǒ fù mǔ shēng le gè hái zi， jì bù shì wǒ xiōng dì， yě bù shì wǒ jiě mèi， cǐ rén shì shéi？”” bù zhī dào，” tā de péng you wèn，” shì shéi？” zhè wèi gù kè huí dá：” shì yī gè fú wù yuán。”
dāng wǒ men zì jǐ bù néng duàn dìng wǒ men shì fǒu zhēn dí míng bai le yī qiè de shí hou， xiàng qí tā rén chóng fù nà gè wǒ men rèn shi de shì shí， jiù shì yī jiàn zuì yú chǔn de shì qing。
english_paragraphs: A waiter at a restaurant asked a customer a riddle: “My mother and father had a child who is neither my brother nor my sister. Who is it?” The customer couldn’t answer, so the waiter told him, “It’s me.”

When the customer got home, he posed the same riddle to a friend: “My parents had a child who is neither my brother nor my sister. Who is it?” “I don’t know,” his friend said. “Who?” The customer answered, “A waiter.”
When we aren’t sure we truly understand something, repeating it to others as though we do is one of the most foolish things we can do.
english_full:
A waiter at a restaurant asked a customer a riddle: “My mother and father had a child who is neither my brother nor my sister. Who is it?” The customer couldn’t answer, so the waiter told him, “It’s me.”

When the customer got home, he posed the same riddle to a friend: “My parents had a child who is neither my brother nor my sister. Who is it?” “I don’t know,” his friend said. “Who?” The customer answered, “A waiter.”

When we aren’t sure we truly understand something, repeating it to others as though we do is one of the most foolish things we can do.
